gloss: busy period; busy season; peak period

definitions.gloss: busy period; busy season; peak season
definitions.explanation: A time of year or period when work, business, or activity is particularly intense and demanding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多忙期|たぼうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}めない→休める：02437_yasumeru⟧。
examples.english: I can't take time off because the end of the year is a busy period.

examples.japanese: {多忙期|たぼうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: During the busy period, overtime increases.

examples.japanese: {多忙期|たぼうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To get through the busy period, we hired temporary staff.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{多忙|たぼう}→多忙：12166_tabou⟧ (very busy) and {期|き} (period, season). Describes a time when workload or business activity peaks. Common in workplace and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多忙期|たぼうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a busy period
- {多忙期|たぼうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: to get through a busy period
- {多忙期|たぼうき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{閑散期|かんさんき}→閑散期：08367_kansanki⟧: busy period and slow period
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多忙期|たぼうき}: the year-end busy period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧: busy season — essentially synonymous; ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧ is slightly more common in business and tourism contexts
- ⟦{閑散期|かんさんき}→閑散期：08367_kansanki⟧: slow period, off-season — the opposite of {多忙期|たぼうき}; when business or activity is at its lowest
- {ピーク: peak — a loanword often used to describe the busiest point within a busy period

USAGE:
Typical busy periods in Japan include {年末年始|ねんまつねんし} (year-end and New Year), {年度末|ねんどまつ} (end of fiscal year in March), and {決算期|けっさんき} (closing of accounts). In the travel industry, お{盆|ぼん} (mid-August) and ゴールデンウィーク (Golden Week in late April/early May) are major busy seasons.
